metadata.description: AgentProof agent skills. Remote audits use AgentProof's agents through its MCP server. Local audits check Next.js, Postgres and Supabase code with your own coding agent.

plugins.name: agentproof-remote-audits
plugins.description: Connects the AgentProof MCP server and runs production audits of live websites with AgentProof's agents. Requires an AgentProof account.

plugins.name: agentproof-local-audits
plugins.description: Security audits of Next.js, Postgres and Supabase code that your coding agent runs locally. Each finding gets a test, a fix and a findings file.
